title: 13 Filipino seafarers aboard vessel hit in Arabian Gulf assisted by DMW
summary: MANILA, Philippines – The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) is providing medical, financial, and repatriation assistance to 13 Filipino crew members of an LNG carrier struck by unidentified objects…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) is providing medical, financial, and repatriation assistance to 13 Filipino crew members of an LNG carrier struck by unidentified objects in the Arabian Gulf on Oct. 30. The vessel, MV Al Mayeda, is operated by Qatar Gas Transport Co. (Nakilat), which separately confirmed the incident and […]...
